children: A stock-market selloff intensified after Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh signaled the U.S. economy is robust, raising the possibility of more rate hikes ahead.
The Dow fell by around 1%, while the Nasdaq and S&P 500 both gave up earlier gains. "This summer's inflation readings do not tell me that underlying trends have meaningfully improved," Warsh said.
